A popular girl in class takes an unexpected interest in the protagonist, who's at the very bottom of the social hierarchy, and shows up at his house…!? She threatens to spread embarrassing photos of him online, or he has to "become her toy"!? This unreasonable coming-of-age master-and-servant story begins now…!

Synopsis
The popular-girl series that received a huge response online has been newly drawn as an easy-to-read 28-page one-shot manga! It also includes a collection of illustrations, manga, previously unreleased artwork, and more that were originally posted on social media! Become the toy of this terrifying yet captivating popular girl!
96 pages total!
